newsitem.title: USA: Comforce expects charge from loan in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Comforce expects charge from loan in Q2.

text.p: Comforce Corp on Wednesday said it expects to take an additional charge in the 1997 second quarter related to its recently completed $25.2 million bridge loan used primarily to purchase Rho Co.
Earlier, Comforce said its first quarter net loss totaled $102,000 or $0.02 per share, compared with net income of $100,000 or $0.01 per share in the 1996 first quarter.
The firm reported a $1.4 million non-recurring financing charge in the first quarter related to the acquisition.

"The company is committed to replacing the relatively expensive bridge financing with a more conventional and lower-cost long-term financing facility," said Christopher Franco, chief executive officer of Comforce.
Both Comforce and Rho are information technology consulting busniesses.

Comforce, which in December purchased Rochester-N.Y. based Azatar Computer Systems Inc, said it plans to add "substantial" additional revenue from new acquisitions in 1997 and has an internal growth target of 18-20 percent.
